_readme: Selection protocol for the 60 real ClinVar transitions of the frozen eval. eval/select_transitions.py applies it to eval/transitions_2024-10_2026-10.tsv (built by scripts/extract_clinvar.py) and writes eval/selected_transitions.json. The seed and this file are committed before the engine exists.
source: SCV-level class changes between archive/2024/submission_summary_2024-10 and archive/submission_summary_2026-10, restricted to genes with kb_scope true in data/genes.json

strata.name: up
strata.expect: duty map with notices where permitted

strata.name: unchanged
strata.expect: no ClassChange is created (same class, possibly a version bump); zero runs

constraints: at most 3 transitions per gene per stratum
at least 5 of the 25 up transitions in genes with review_always true (to test NEEDS_REVIEW routing)
unchanged controls are SCVs present in both snapshots with the same normalised class; half of them must have a version bump

worlds.heldout: 30 seeds chosen by labeller B; only sha256(seed list as JSON) is committed before engine freeze (eval/heldout_seeds.sha256); the list is revealed at final eval (commit-reveal)
